question: Can weakly-correlated, cross-sectionally orthogonal T-1 factors add robust information to LIMIT_ADJUSTED_MOMENTUM?

preregistration.correlation_measure: daily cross-sectional Spearman (Pearson on percentile ranks)
preregistration.performance_gate: >=3.00% CAGR improvement and no worse MDD under BASE and CONSERVATIVE
preregistration.orthogonalization: daily OLS residual of factor percentile rank on clean-momentum percentile rank; residual reranked cross-sectionally
preregistration.weights: equal weight r_base and each selected orthogonal rank; no optimization

factor_definitions.PULLBACK5: lower recent 5d return inside the already-strong 20d universe
factor_definitions.HIGH_CLOSE_LOC1: T-1 close nearer top of daily range
factor_definitions.LOW_UPPER_SHADOW1: smaller T-1 upper shadow relative to preclose
factor_definitions.LOW_AMPLITUDE1: smaller T-1 high-low range relative to preclose
factor_definitions.LOW_TURNOVER_ACCEL5: T-1 turnover closer to its prior-5d mean
